# WSCapp

WSCapp is a free unofficial World Scholar's Cup 2026 study app at https://wscapp.app/.

It helps students prepare for the World Scholar's Cup 2026 theme, "Are We There Yet?", with interactive study routes, raw-content explanations, practice games, Alpacards, Debate Lab, and a room-scoped multiplayer campus.

Important pages:

- Home: https://wscapp.app/
- WSC 2026 study guide: https://wscapp.app/wsc-2026-study-guide/
- WSC 2026 practice: https://wscapp.app/wsc-2026-practice/
- Debate Lab: https://wscapp.app/debate-lab/
- Scholar's Challenge practice: https://wscapp.app/scholars-challenge/
- Alpacards: https://wscapp.app/alpacards/
- Multiplayer campus: https://wscapp.app/multiplayer-campus/

Disclaimer:

WSCapp is an independent, free, unofficial study app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by World Scholar's Cup.
